selected_practice.operative_rule: Before fixing a defect, name its category and root mechanism. If that mechanism has repeatable sibling variants, include a proportionate class-level guard capable of catching a plausible variant absent from the original report.
selected_practice.causal_reason: Correcting only the reported input can leave the shared mechanism able to fail at another input or call site. A guard derived from that mechanism checks a transferable property; exercising an unreported sibling distinguishes category protection from replaying the original example.
limits: Keep the fix local and record why when evidence shows no repeatable sibling, no stable guard is possible, or guard cost exceeds the bounded risk.
This grants no authority for unbounded cleanup or changes outside the authorized fix.
Preserve the raw failure record; enrichment can aid investigation, but pre-filtering can hide the causal mechanism.
Postmortem categories/actions, including monitoring failure, apply when the project operates incidents or postmortems; that target condition was not supplied.
Correcting a contributing harness default/interface/context route and removing redundant reminders is conditional on a harness contribution; none was established for the target.

first_assessment.finding_from_supplied_fact: The stated guide covers reproduction and correction of the reported case. That statement does not require identifying a repeatable mechanism, seeking siblings, or justifying the omission of a class guard.
first_assessment.what_this_practice_could_add: At the existing guide owner, add a conditional step to identify the category/root mechanism, determine whether it has repeatable siblings, and, when proportionate, protect the mechanism and verify an unreported plausible sibling. Preserve the original reproduction check and allow a reasoned local-only fix under the source exceptions.
first_assessment.benefit: A fix can prevent a related recurrence rather than merely close the observed case.
first_assessment.cost_and_tradeoff: The step adds investigation and guard maintenance. The exceptions prevent speculative broad cleanup and an expensive guard for a small bounded risk.
first_assessment.what_does_not_follow: The supplied sentence cannot establish that the real target lacks equivalent coverage elsewhere or that its current tests are inadequate. No specific defect mechanism or guard was verified.
first_assessment.non_application_case: For a genuinely isolated defect without a repeatable sibling, or where no stable proportionate guard exists, retain the local reproduction/correction and record that evidence instead of forcing a class guard.
first_assessment.proposal_status: Source-supported recommendation on the bounded supplied fact; not adopted, implemented or empirically tried in a target project.

material_finding.title: Extraction wording can gate implementer-selected investigation on an owner-named practice
material_finding.mechanism: The adoption rule makes an explicitly bounded practice request the only stated escape from the full survey, and the operation card assumes the practice is named in that request. C has a bounded authorized task but no named practice. A literal consumer can therefore conclude that it must ask the owner to name the practice or perform a full survey before inspecting a useful candidate. The ordinary task and governance rules support proceeding, leaving the reader to reconcile competing signals.
material_finding.affected_consumer: An implementer diagnosing an authorized task who selects a candidate method from the template, rather than receiving an explicit request to learn the discipline or extract a named practice.
material_finding.impact: An unnecessary owner interruption or a potentially large source survey can delay or discourage useful investigation. The exact frequency and time cost are unknown; this countercase establishes the wording path, not measured adoption incidence.
material_finding.when_it_does_not_matter: A broad discipline-learning request legitimately takes the complete survey, and an owner who explicitly asks for a named practice fits the current extraction card. Those are the cases exercised by A and B.
material_finding.conformance_assessment: Source-before-fit preserves the original correction. Requiring the owner to name the practice, or treating its absence as a full-survey trigger, is an additional gate not needed by that correction and conflicts with preserving ordinary engineering discretion.
material_finding.not_an_actual_execution_blocker: I selected the coherent ordinary-task route and did not pause for a new owner decision. The finding concerns public wording and the plausible decision it induces; it is not evidence that this consumer was unable to proceed.
material_finding.repair_authority: Root owns any source correction; this consumer made none.
